title: Two marks in one navigation pattern

location.format: Editorial comparison of desktop component captures at 1120 CSS px

slide_intent: Teach designers to decide which parts of a shared navigation pattern should signal ownership. A stable set of controls can help visitors carry their bearings from one branded surface to another.
strategic_value: Mozilla and Firefox can distinguish publisher from product at the left edge of the header while keeping familiar menu actions and the Firefox download in corresponding positions.
demonstration: The upper bar starts with the black Mozilla signature. The lower bar starts with the multicolor Firefox symbol and wordmark. Both show two sample menu labels on the left and a blue outlined Download Firefox button on the right.
practical_value: Compare both branded variants before changing a shared header. Use the preview to place the appropriate mark while preserving menu grouping and the position of the download action.
